1); Eccl 3:9 in (that, in) which (4c); Isa 47:12 (see

2).

b. adverb in (the place) where: above 4b (γ).

c. conjunction in that, inasmuch as, Gen 39:9, 23; Eccl 7:2; 8:4; compare .

d. Jonah 1:8 לְמִי בַּאֲשֶׁר‎ on account of whom ? (לְ בַּאֲשֶׁר‎ on account of, framed on model of Aramaic בְּדִיל‎: see below שֶׁל‎).

כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ see below כְּ‎.

מֵאֲשֶׁר‎17 a. from (or than) that which (him, them, etc., that . . .) Gen 3:11; Exod 29:27 (twice in verse); Num 6:11 (see Lev 4:26; Josh 10:11; Judg 16:30; Isa 47:13 +; than that . . . Eccl 3:22; מֵאֲשֶׁר לְבַד‎ Est 4:11.

b. adverb from (the place) where: above 4a (β).

c. conjunction from (the fact) that . . ., since Isa 43:4.

כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ conjunction according as, as, when (compare for the combined Aramaic כַּד כְּדִי,‎) —

1 according to that which, according as, as:

a. Gen 34:12 I will give אלי תאמרו כאשׁר‎ according as ye shall (or may) say unto me, 44:1; Exod 8:23; Num 22:8; 1Sam 2:16; Gen 34:22 if we are circumcised נמולים הם כאשׁר‎; 41:21 בתחלה כאשׁר‎ as at the beginning, so בראשׁונה ׳כ‎ Josh 8:5-6, 2Sam 7:10; Exod 5:13 התבן בהיות ׃כאשׁר‎ Gen 7:9 they came in two by two אלהִים צוה כאשׁר‎, as God commanded Noah; so, or similarly, very often, especially in P, 7:16; 8:21; 12:4; 17:23; 21:1 (twice in verse); Exod 16:24; 39:1, 5, 7; Num 3:16, 42 etc.; י דבר ׳כאשׁר‎ Deut 1:21; 2:1; 6:3, 19 +? Deuteronomy.

b. answered, for increased emphasis, by כֵּן‎ (compare כְּ‎ 2d), Gen 50:12 צִוָּם כאשׁר כן ויעשׂו‎, Exod 7:10, 20; Gen 18:5 (J) דברת כאשׁר חעשׂח כן‎, Exod 10:10 (iron.), Amos 5:14 (do.); in opposed to order, Judg 1:7 לי שׁלם כן עשׂיתי, כאשׁר‎, Exod 7:6 י צוה ׳כאשׁר עשׂו כן‎, compare 12:28, 50; 39:43; Num 5:4; Numbers 17:26; 36:10 (all P); with imperfect (frequently) 2:17 (P) יסעו כן יחנו כאשׁר‎; of degree = the more. . . the more, Exod 1:12 יפרץ וכן ירבה כן אתו יענּו וכאשׁר‎, compare 17:11 (JE) ישׁר יריםו֗֗֗גבר כאשׁר ׳והיה‎ according as he held up, etc., Israel prevailed; in an oath or solemn promise, Num 14:28 אעשׂה כן דברתם כאשׁר לא אם‎, Deut 28:63 (Jer 31:28), 1Kin 1:30; Isa 10:11; 14:24; 52:14f. (see כֵּן‎ 2b).

e. כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה‎ (compare כְּ הָיָה‎) to be as if, Job 10:19 אהיה הייתי לא כאשׁר‎, Zech 10:6 זנחתים לא כאשׁר והיו‎.

2 with a casual force, in so far as, since (German demgemäss dass), Gen 26:29 if thou doest us no harm נגענוך לא כאשׁר‎ according as, in so far as, we have not touched thee; Num 27:14 פי מריתם כאשׁר‎ inasmuch as ye have defied my mouth, Judg 6:27; 1Sam 28:18 (answered by כן על‎), 2Kin 17:26; Micah 3:4.

Gen 12:11; 20:13; 24:22, 52; Exod 32:19 + often; Gen 43:14 שׁכלתי שׁכלתי כאשׁר‎ when I am bereaved, I am bereaved ! an expression of resignation, so Est 4:16 אבדתי אבדתי כאשׁר‎. conjunction (compare אֲשֶׁר‎ 8); — a. that, after רָאָה‎ Eccl 2:13; 3:18, יָרַע‎ 1:17; 2:14; 9:5; Job 19:19 (?), דִּבֶּר‎ Eccl 2:15, אָמַר‎ 8:14, אוֺת עָשָׂה‎ Judg 6:17; as subject of sentence, Eccl 3:13; 5:15; also in the phrases, (a) what is ... that ? Song 5:9 (usually כִּי‎; see מָךְ‎ 1d b), שֶּׁ  הָיָה מֶה‎ how comes it that ... ? Eccl 7:10; (b) Song 3:4 מֵהֶם שֶׁעָבַרְתּת כִּמְעַט‎ hardly (was it) that (German kaum dass) I had passed, etc., Eccl 7:14 יִמְצָא שֶׁלּאֹ דִּדבְרַת עַל‎ to the intent that ..., 5:15 שֶׁבֶּא כָּלעֻֿמַּת‎ exactly as ..., 12:9 שֶׁ תֵר‎ besides that, שֶּׁ  עַד‎ (ּ עַד‎ Judg 5:7) until that Psa 123:2; Song 2:7, 17 + (see III. עַד‎ II 1 a a and b; compare Late Hebrew Yoma 5:1), while 1:12 (ib. 2d); עָשָׂהשֶּׁ ‎ to make or cause that ..., Eccl 3:14 (compare Ezek 36:27). b. involving a reason (compare אֲשֶׁר‎ 8c), because, since, Song 1:6 (twice in verse); 5:2; Eccl 2:18 b. Hence שֵׁלָּמָה‎ Song 1:7 since why ? = lest (see מָה‎ 4d b). 4 compounds: a. בְּשֶּׁ ‎, i. q. בַּאֲשֶׁר‎ c (p. 84a) in that, seeing that, Eccl 2:16; also (according to ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ᵑ0‎ Hu De) Gen 6:3 בָשָׂר הוּא בְּשַׁגַּם‎ because that he also is flesh; but see שָׁגַג‎. b. כּשֶּׁ ‎, i. q. כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ p. 455: — (a) according as Eccl 5:14; 12:7; (b) when (so often in Late Hebrew, as Ab 1:8 (3 t. in verse); 1:14) 9:12; 10:3. c. מִשֶּּׁ ‎, i. q. מֵאֲשֶׁר‎ a (p. 84:a), 2Kin 6:12 מִשֶּׁלָּנוּ מִי‎ who of those that are ours ? (but Klo KmpKau Benz מְגַלֵּנוּ‎ who betrays us ? compare ᵐ5‎); Eccl 5:4 than that (compare מֵאֲשֶׁר‎ 3:22), + 2:24 (read מִשֶּׁיּאֹכַל‎ with Ew De, etc.; compare 3:22). d. שֶׁל‎, like אֲשֶׁרלְ‎ (אֲשֶׁר‎ 7b), a mark of the Genitive: thrice, adding slight emphasis to the suffix, Song 1:6 = 8:12 שֶׁלִּי כַּרְמִי‎ my vineyard (literally my vineyard, which is mine), 3:7 שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹה מִטָּתוֺ‎ (so often in Late Hebrew, but without any special emphasis, as Aboth 1:12 שׁלאֿהרן מתלמידיווּ הֲוֵי‎ be of Aaron's disciples, 2:1 שֶׁלמִֿצְוֺת שְׂכָרָן‎, 2:2; 3:2 שׁלמֿלכות בשׁלומהּ מתפלל הֲוֵי‎; compare in Syriac, as Luke 6:42 my words, Nö§ 225). And with בְּשֶׁל בְּ,‎ literally through that which belongs to or concerns, pleonastic for on account of (a late, unidiomatic translation of Aramaic בְּרִיל‎, from דִּי בְּ,‎, and לְ‎, as in Onk Gen 12:13 בדילי‎ on my account, 30:27; 39:5 מָא בְּדִיל יוֺסֵף, בְּדִיל‎ on account of what ? Judg 8:1; 2Sam 9:1; 1Kin 11:12, 39, etc.), Jonah 1:7 בְּשֶׁלְּמִי‎ on account of whom ? (|| 1:8 לְמִי בַּאֲשֶׁר‎; probably a gloss), 1:12 בְּשֶׁלִּי‎ an account of me (בְּדִילִי מַן, בְּדִיל ᵑ7‎); Eccl 8:17 לְבַקֵּשׁ הָאָדָם יַעֲמֹל אֲשֶׁר בְּשֶׁל‎ on account of (the fact) that (= seeing that) man labours, etc. (unidiomatic translation of Aramaic דְּ בְּדִיל‎ because that, as Gen 6:3 בִּסְרָא דְּאִינוּן בְּדִיל‎, 39:9 אִיתְּתֵיהּ דְּאַתְּ בְּרִיל‎ [for Hebrew אִשְׁתּוֺ אַתְּ בַּאֲשֶׁר‎]; Palmyrene די בדיל‎ Ldzb233, — in Tariff 1:4 (CookeN. Semitic Inscr. 320) = ἐπειδή).

[שֹׁא‎] see [ שׁוֺא‎].

ברד.def:
H1258. barad

בָּרַד‎ verb denominative hail, הַיָּ֑עַר בְּרֶדֶת וּבָרַד‎ consecutive Isa 32:19 it shall hail.

ברה.def:
H1262. barah

I. בָּרָה‎ verb eat (Assyrian barû & derivatives ZimBP 31) —

Qal Perfect 2Sam 12:17; Imperfect אֶבְרֶה‎ 13:6, 10 eat bread (בְּרוּלְֿכֶם‎ 1Sam 17:8 scribal error for לכם בחרו‎ 1Kin 18:25 DrSm 107).

Pi`el Infinitive לְבָרוֺת‎ Lam 4:10 for devouring.

Hiph`il Imperfect תַּבְרֵנִי‎ 2Sam 13:5; Infinitive לְהַבְרוֺת‎ 3:35 cause to eat bread.

ברוך.def:
H1263. Baruk

בָּרוּךְ‎ proper name, masculine (blessed)

1 friend and amanuensis of Jeremiah Jer 32:12-13, 16; 36:4-32; 43:3, 6; 45:1-2,.

2 a priest, son of Zabbai (Zaccai) Neh 3:20; 10:7.

3 son of Colhozeh, of the tribe of Judah Neh 11:5.

ברור.def:
H1305. barar

[בָּרַר‎] verb purify, select (compare Assyrian barâru, be shining, in derivatives ZimBP 46. 73 BelserBAS ii. 154; Arabic pious, kind, true; he was pious, good, virtuous, honest) —

Qal Perfect בָּרוֺתִי‎ Ezek 20:38; Infinitive suffix לְבָרָם‎ Eccl 3:18, Ges§ 67 R, 3; compare לָבוּר‎ 9:1 (si vera lectio) as metaplastic form, but on text see בּוּר‎ above; Participle passive masculine בָּרוּר‎ Job 33:3-4t.; feminine בְּרוּרָה‎ Neh 5:18; Zeph 3:9; —

1 purge out, purify: הַמֹּרְדִים מִכֶּם וּבָרוֺתִי‎ and I will purge out from among you the rebels Ezek 20:38; בְּרוּרָה שָׂפָה‎ a purified lip Zeph 3:9; מִלֵּל֑וּ בָּרוּר‎ utter in a pure, sincere manner Job 33:3.

2 choose, select, only Participle and in Chronicler: chosen, valiant men 1Chr 7:40; porters 9:22; musicians 16:41; sheep Neh 5:18.

3 cleanse, make shining, polish, passive participle בָּרוּר חֵץ‎ polished arrow Isa 49:2 (compare De & Jer 51:11 below)

4 test, prove Eccl 3:18 הָאֱלֹהִים לְבָרָם‎ that God may prove them (RV); — on 9:1 see בּוּר‎.

Niph`al הִבָּרוּ‎ Isa 52:11; Participle נָבָר‎ 2Sam 22:27 (= Psa 18:27); — purify oneself:

a. ceremonially, the bearers of the sacred vessels Isa 52:11.

b. morally 2Sam 22:27 = Psa 18:27.

Pi`el Infinitive לְבָרֵר‎ Dan 11:35 purify (|| לַלְבֵּן לִצְרוֺף,‎).

Hiph`il 1. Infinitive לְהָבַר‎ Jer 4:11 purify, cleanse.

2 Imperative הַחִצִּים הָבֵרוּ‎ Jer 51:11 polish arrows (see 3 above).

Hithpa`el 1. Imperfect יִתְבָּרֲרוּ‎ Dan 12:10 purify oneself.

2 תִּתְבָּרַר‎ Psa 18:27 = תִּתָּבָר‎ 2Sam 22:27 shew oneself pure, just, kind.

ברוש.def:
H1265. berosh

בְּרוֺשׁ‎ noun masculineHosea 14:9 cypress or fir (Assyrian burâšu COTGlossary Aramaic בּרוֺתא‎, , compare בְּרוֺת‎ below, see also Greek βράθυ, Latin bratum, cypress, juniper (PS); in favour of cypress, also ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ & so Thes; in favour of fir or pine, ᵑ9‎ Rob in Rob-Ges (because cypress not now indigenous on Lebanon); compare also RSProph. iv. n. 20 who lays stress on Phoenician proper name, of a location בשם אי‎ (= איברושים‎) = Greek Πιτυοῦσαι i.e. isle of firs; — see further SchroedPhön. Spr. 99 LöwNo. 59 & Brathu as name of Hermon Philo Byblus in EusebPraep. Evang. i. 10) — בְּרוֺשׁ‎ 14:9 4t.; בִּרוֺשִׁים‎ 2Sam 6:5 + 11: t., בְּרשִׁים‎ Nahum 2:4, בְּרוֺשָׁיו‎ Isa 37:24, בְּרשָׁיו‎ 2Kin 19:23; —

1 (literal) a noble tree, usually || ארז‎ (except 2Sam 6:5; 1Kin 6:34; 2Chr 3:5; Psa 104:17; Isa 55:13; Hosea 14:9; Nahum 2:4); as standing and growing Isa 14:8; 37:24 = 2Kin 19:23; Isa 41:19; 55:13 (|| הֲדַס‎) 60:13 (|| לבנון כבוד‎ = ארז‎) Psa 104:17.

2 simile of luxuriance, stateliness Ezek 31:8, productiveness Hosea 14:9 (Now thinks cypress), figurative for spear-shafts Nahum 2:4 Hi-St, but פרשׁים ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎; figurative for mighty men Zech 11:2.

3 as material (always plural), for building temple (ב ׳עצי‎) 1 Kings 5:22; 1 Kings 5:24; 1Kin 6:34; compare 9:11; 2Chr 2:7; ב ׳עץ‎ (singular) 3:5 (compare Baer's note); ב ׳צלעות‎ 1Kin 6:15; for ships (no עץ‎) Ezek 27:5; — ברושׁים עֲצֵי בְּכֹל‎ 2Sam 6:5 apparently = with all musical instruments made of fir, but || 1Chr 13:8 וּבְשִׁירִים בְּכָלעֹֿז‎ & so here ᵐ5‎ We Dr.

ברות.def:
H1266. beroth

[בְּרוֺת‎] noun masculine id. (Aramaic (probably North-Palestinian) form of same) only plural בְּרוֺתִים‎ || אֲרָזִים‎ Song 1:17; reference to arbour of trees as their home, compare אֶרֶז‎.

ברותה.def:
H1268. Berothah

בֵּרוֺ֫תָה‎ proper name, of a location near Hamath Ezek 47:16 (contracted from בְּאֵרוֺתָה‎ ?), compare following; — hardly = Berytus (Beirût) with which form of name might agree see Steph. Byzant. and others in MoversPhen. ii. 1. 110 n.; perhaps Bereit¹n near Baalbek, see FurrerZPV viii. 34.

בֵּרֹתַי‎ proper name, of a location belonging to Hadadezer of Zoba 2Sam 8:8; perhaps = foregoing.

ברזית.def:
H1269. Birzoth

ברזות‎ proper name, feminine (?) descendant of Asher (perhaps בִּרְזָא‎ foramen, Thes, or woman whose beauties are apparent) 1Chr 7:31 Kt (Qr בִּרְזָ֑יִת‎).

ברזל.def:
H1270. barzel

בַּרְזֶל‎ noun masculineDeut 19:5 iron (with ל‎ afform.; from piercing ? Late Hebrew id., Aramaic id., מַּדְזֶל‎, , Phoenician ברזל‎, Assyrian parzillu COTGloss, (Arabic fetter is loan-word)) — always absolute ׳ב‎ Gen 4:22 74t. (בַּרְזֶל֑‎ 4:22 etc.); —

1 iron, literally:

a. iron-ore, stone containing iron, Deut 8:9; Job 28:2;

b. as raw material (to be worked) Gen 4:22; 1Chr 22:3, 14, 16; 29:2 (twice in verse); 29:7; 2Chr 2:6; 2:13; 24:12; Isa 44:12;

c. as article of commerce Ezek 27:12, 19;

d. as material of furniture, utensils, implements, etc., ב ׳עֶרֶשׂ‎ Deut 3:11, ב ׳רֶכֶב‎ Josh 17:16, 18; Judg 1:19; 4:3, 13, ב ׳כְּלֵי‎ Josh 6:19, 24 compare 1Kin 6:7; Num 35:16, ׳עֵטבֿ‎ Job 19:24 & figurative Jer 17:1, הַבּ ׳חֲרִצֵי‎ 2Sam 12:31= 1Chr 20:3, הַבּ ׳מַגְזְרוֺת‎ 2Sam 12:31 cutting instrument of iron, see Amos 1:3, ב ׳כַּבְלֵי‎ Psa 149:8 (|| זִקִּיִם‎), ב ׳נֵשֶׁק‎ Job 20:24, ב ׳קַרְנֵי‎ 1Kin 22:11 2Chr 18:10, ב ׳קִיר‎ & ב ׳מַחֲבַת‎ Ezek 4:3; ב ׳בְּרִיחֵי‎, i.e. of Babylon, ag. Cyrus Isa 45:2; compare 1Sam 17:7 & Isa 60:17 (twice in verse) (figurative)

2 tool of iron Deut 27:5; Josh 8:31; Prov 27:17 (twice in verse); Eccl 10:10; Isa 10:34 (metaphor); head of an axe Deut 19:5; 2Kin 6:5-6, so weapon 2Sam 23:7; Job 41:19; compare also Num 31:22; Josh 22:8 where iron as spoil of war.

3 iron in figure of unwatered earth Deut 28:23; of Egyptian bondage, הַבּ ׳כּוּר‎ 4:20; 1Kin 8:51; Jer 11:4; of oppression ב ׳עֹל‎ Deut 28:48; Jer 28:14 compare 28:13; of strength 15:12 (twice in verse); compare ׳ב מִנְעָלֶיךָ‎ Deut 33:25 & Micah 4:13 ב ׳קֶרֶן‎; of prophet, firm through Yahweh's might, ׳ב עַמּוּד‎ Jer 1:18; of distress, ב ׳בְּרִיחֵי‎ Psa 107:16 compare 107:10 of judgments of ׳י‎, & 105:18; ב ׳שֵׁבֶט‎ 2:9; of evil-doers, Jer 6:28; Ezek 22:18, 20; simile of scorching sky Lev 26:19; ב ׳מְטִיל‎ of bones of hippopotamus Job 40:18; ב ׳גִּיד‎ of obstinate neck of Israel Isa 48:4.

ברזלי.def:
H1271. Barzillay

בַּרְזִלַּי‎ proper name, masculine (man of iron) **no adjective from names of metals; perhaps Aramaic, and בַּר‎ = son NesZPV xv.257; AJSL Apr. 1897. 173. —

1 a Gileadite 2Sam 17:27; 19:32; 19:33; 19:35; 19:40; 1Kin 2:7; בַּרְזִלָּי֑‎ 2Sam 19:34; Ezra 2:61 = Neh 7:63 עַלשְֿׁמָם וַיִּקָּרֵא הַגִּלְעָדִי בַּרְזִלַּי מִבְּנוֺת לָקַח אֲשֶׁר בַרְזִלַּי בְּנֵי‎, where 2nd Barzillai = above, & former is

2 a priest Ezra 2:61 = Neh 7:63, who adopted name בַּרְזִלַּי‎.

3 2Sam 21:8 a Meholathite.

ברח.def:
H1272. barach

בָּרַח‎ verb go through, flee (compare German durchgehen (Arabic go away, withdraw, flee) —

Qal Perfect בָּרַח‎ Gen 31:22 9t., בָּֽרְחוּ‎ Job 9:25, בָּרָ֑חוּ‎ Isa 22:3; Imperfect יִבְרַח‎ Job 20:24, יִבְרָ֑ח‎ 27:22; Neh 6:11, וַיִּבְרַח‎ Gen 31:21 13t.; 3 feminine singular וַתִּבְרַח‎ 16:6, אֶבְרָ֑ח‎ Psa 139:7, יִבְרְחוּ‎ Jer 52:7, וַיִּבְרְחוּ‎ 2Sam 4:3-4t., נִבְרָחָ֑ה‎ 15:14; Imperative בְּרַח‎ Gen 27:43 3t., בִּרְחוּ‎ Isa 48:20; Infinitive absolute בָּרוֺחַ‎ Job 27:22; construct בְּרֹחַ‎ 1Sam 23:6 3t., בִּרוֺחַ‎ Jonah 1:3; suffix בָּרְחִי‎ 1Kin 2:7, בָּרְחֲךָ‎ Gen 31:5, בָּרְחוֺ‎ 35:7 2t.; —

1 go or pass though, of bar, אֶתהַֿבְּרִיחַלִ֗֗֗בְרֹחַ וַיַּעַשׂ‎ Exod 36:33 (P).

2 flee Gen 31:20; 21:21; 31:22 (E) Exod 14:5 (J) Judg 9:21; 1Sam 19:12, 18; 22:17; 2Sam 13:34, 37, 38 (strike out Dr compare We) 15:14; Isa 22:3; Jer 4:29; 26:21; 39:4; 52:7; Neh 6:11; figurative of days fleeing away Job 9:25; of man, like a shadow 14:2; with מִן‎ flee from a place 1Sam 20:1; 2Sam 19:10; 9+ מֵעַל‎ person) Isa 48:20, a weapon Job 20:24; a person, with מֵאֵת‎ 1Kin 11:23, usually with מִמְּנֵי‎ Gen 16:6, 8; 31:27; 35:1, 7; Exod 2:15 (all J E) Judg 11:3; 2Sam 21:11; 1Kin 2:7; 12:2 2Chr 10:2; Psa 3:1; 57:1 (titles) 139:7; Jonah 1:10; י ׳מִיַּד‎ figurative Job 27:22; flee to, with accusative place 1Sam 27:4; 1Kin 11:40; Hosea 12:13; with place & לְ‎ Neh 13:10; with place & ָ  ה‎ locative Jonah 1:3; 4:2; 2Sam 4:3; with place & אֶלֿ‎ Num 24:11; Amos 7:12; with אֶלֿ‎ & person 1Sam 23:6; Gen 27:43 (J) 1Kin 2:39; 11:40; אַחֲרֵי‎ & person 1Sam 22:20; flee, followed by infinitive 1Kin 11:17; Dan 10:7.

3 flee = hasten, come quickly Song 8:14.

Hiph`il Perfect הִבְרִיחוּ‎ 1Chr 8:13; Imperfect יַבְרִיחַ‎ Prov 19:26; suffix יַבְרִיחֶנּוּ‎ Job 41:20, וָאַבְרִחֵהוּ‎ Neh 13:28, וַיַּבְרִיחוּ‎ 1Chr 12:15; Participle מַבְרִחַ‎ Exod 26:28; —

1 pass through literal Exod 26:28 (P) compare Qal. 2. cause to flee, put to flight, animal Job 41:20, men 1Chr 8:18; 12:16; drive away Prov 19:16; Neh 13:28 (followed by מֵעָלַי‎).

ברי.def:
H1275. Beri

בֵּרִי‎ proper name, masculine a descendant of Asher 1 Chronicles 7:86 (perhaps = בְּאֵרִי‎).

בֵּרִי‎ proper name, masculine see below באר‎ p. 92.

בריא.def:
H1277. bari

בָּרִיא‎ adjective fat — Psa 73:4; Judg 3:17; plural בְּרִיאִים‎ 1Kin 5:3; construct בְּרִיאֵי‎ Dan 1:15; feminine בְּרִיאָה‎ Hab 1:16 2t. + Ezek 34:20 בִּרְיָה‎; Hi Ol§ 171 a בְּרִיָּה‎, < בריאה‎; plural בְּרִיאוֺת‎ Gen 41:5 3t.; בְּרִיאֹת‎ 41:2, 4; — fat, cattle בקר‎ 41:2, 4, 5, 7, 18, 20 (E) 1Kin 5:3; sheep Ezek 34:3, 20; Zech 11:16; food Hab 1:16; ב ׳אישׁ‎ fat man Judg 3:17; בשׂר בריאי‎ Dan 1:15; ׳ב אולם‎ their body fat Psa 73:4.

בריאה.def:
H1278. beriah

בְּרִיאָה‎ noun feminine a creation, thing created, as preternatural, unparalleled; accusative of congnate meaning with verb י ׳יִבְרָא ׳אִםבֿ‎ Num 16:30, compare בָּרָא‎ Qal 3, Niph`al 3.

בריה.def:
H1279. biryah

בִּרְיָה‎ noun feminine food 2Sam 13:5, 7, 10; Ezek 34:20 see בָּרִיא‎.

בריח.def:
H1281. bariach

I. [בָּרִיחַ‎] adjective fleeing ( = ֗֗֗ בַּרִּיחַ‎) בִָּרחַ׃ נָחָשׁ‎ Job 26:13 of eclipse-dragon, בָרִחַ נָחָשׁ לִוְיָתָן‎ Isa 27:1 (probably figurative of Assyrians); as substantive בָּרִיחִים‎ 43:14 as fugitives (for other views compare Comm.); so probably also 15:5 בריחיה‎, see בְּרִיחַ‎.

ברים.def:
H1276. Beri

בֵּרִים‎ 2Sam 20:14 obscure, many after ᵑ9‎ read בַּחֻרִים‎; Klo prefers חַבִּכְּרִים‎ after ᵐ5‎ & so Dr.

בְּרִית‎ see below II. ברה‎; see also אֵל‎

3 בַּעַל‎

4

בֹּרִית‎ see below ברר‎.

בריעה.def:
H1283. Beriah

בְּרִיעָה‎ proper name, masculine 1. a son of Asher Gen 46:17 (twice in verse); Num 26:44-45, 1Chr 7:30-31,.

2 son of Ephraim 1Chr 7:23 (where explanation as if from בְּרָעָה‎).

I. בַּת‎587 noun feminine daughter (= *בַּנְתְּ‎ from בן‎; Phoenician בת‎, MI בנת‎ plural maidens, Assyrian bintu WincklerSargon, Glossary, Arabic ; Sabean בנת בת,‎ DHMZMG 1883, 391 CISiv. l, No. 6. 21; Aramaic ) — ׳ב‎ absolute Exod 1:16 +; construct Gen 11:29 +; suffix בִּתִּי‎ Deut 22:16 +; בִּתְּךָ‎ Gen 29:18 +; בִּתֵּנוּ‎ 34:17 etc.; plural בָּנוֺת‎ 5:4 +; construct בְּנוֺת‎ 6:2 +; suffix בְּנֹתַי‎ 31:26+; בְּנוֺתֶיךָ‎ 19:12 +; בְּנֹתָם‎ 34:21; בְּנוֺתֵיהֶם‎ Deut 12:31 +, etc.; —

1 daughter, female child, born of a woman Gen 30:21; 34:1; Exod 1:16, 22; 21:4; Lev 12:6; Hosea 1:6 compare Gen 20:12; Lev 18:9; Deut 27:22 +; begotten by a man Gen 5:4, 7, 10; 11:11, 13, 15 compare 11:29; 19:8; 20:12; 28:2; Lev 19:9; Deut 27:22 +; often || בֵּן‎ son Gen 5:4, 7 + (see בֵּן‎); compare in allegory of Jehoash 2Kin 14:9 2Chr 25:18; note especially הָאָדָם בְּנוֺת‎ i.e. human women Gen 6:2, 4; הַמְּטַנָּה בִּתְּךָ‎ thy younger daughter 29:18 (compare הַצְּעִירָה‎ 29:26 opposed to הַבְּכִירָה‎); הַגְּדוֺלָה בִּתִּי‎ my eldest daughter 1Sam 18:17; בַּתֿ(הַ)מֶּלֶךְ‎ = princess2Chr 22:11; 2Kin 9:34; Dan 11:6 compare 2Sam 13:18; Jer 41:10; 43:6; Psa 45:10; compare as term of praise בַּתנָֿדִיב‎ Cant 7:2; in particular

a. girl called בִּתֵּנוּ‎ by father and brothers Gen 34:17 compare בִּתְּכֶם‎ 34:8.

b. of adopted daughter Est 2:7, 15.

g. בָּנָיו בְּנוֺת‎ = granddaughters Gen 46:7 (P) compare Lev 18:10 & 18:17 (H); note also Gen 37:35, where בנותיו‎ must include other than actual daughters.

i. often plural as designation of women of a particular city, land, or people: צִיּוֺן בְּנוֺת‎ Isa 3:16-17, 4:4; Song 3:11 compare Isa 49:22; 60:4; Lam 3:51; יְרוּשָׁלַם בְּנוֺת‎ Song 1:5; 2:7; 3:5, 10; 5:8, 16; 8:4; בְּנוֺתשִֿׁילוֺ‎ Judg 21:21 (twice in verse); רַבָּה בְּנוֺת‎ Jer 49:3; observe transitional phrase הָעִיר אַנְשֵׁי בְּנוֺת‎ Gen 24:13; further כְּנָ֑עַן בְּנוֺת‎ 28:1, 6, 8; 36:2 (all P) compare ׳ב הַכְּנַעֲנִי‎ 24:3, 37 (J); הָאָרֶץ בְּנוֺת‎ 27:46; 34:1 (both P); מוֺאָב בְּנוֺת‎ Num 25:1; Isa 16:2 compare Num 21:29; ׳ב חֵת‎ Gen 27:46 (twice in verse) (P); ׳ב מְּלִשְׁתִּים‎ Judg 14:1-2, 2Sam 1:20 || ׳ב הָֽעֲרֵלִים‎ 1:20 (poetry); ׳ב יִשְׂרָאֵל‎ Judg 11:40; 1Sam 1:24 (poetry); ׳ב יְהוּרָה‎ Psa 48:12; 97:8; ׳ב מְנַשֶּׁה‎ Josh 17:6; ׳ב דָּן‎2Chr 2:13; compare בַּתלַֿוֵי‎ Exod 2:1 i.e. a woman of tribe of Levi; also ׳ב אַחֶיךָ‎ Judg 14:3; ׳ב עַמֶּ֑ךָ‎ Ezek 13:17. — בֵּתצִֿיּוֺן‎ etc. see below 3 below

2 young women, women Gen 30:13 (J) Prov 31:29; Song 2:2; 6:9; בֹּטְחוֺת בָּנוֺת‎ Isa 32:9; also הַנָּשִׁים בַּת‎ Dan 11:17.

3 with name of city, land, or people, poetic personification of that city or inhabitants, etc.: בַּתצִֿיּוֺן‎ Isa 1:8; 10:32; 16:1; 62:11; Micah 1:13; 4:8, 10, 13; Jer 4:31; 6:2, 23; Zeph 3:14; Zechariah 2:14; Zech 9:9; Psa 9:15; Lam 1:6; 2:1, 4; 4:22; even בתצֿיון זִקְנֵי‎ 2:10; ב ׳חוֺמַת ׳צ‎ 2:8; 2:18; also ב ׳צֿ׳בְּתוּלַת‎ 2Kin 19:21 = Isa 37:22; Lam 2:13; ב ׳צֿ׳שְׁבִּיָּה‎ Isa 52:2; ׳ב יְרוּשָׁלַם‎ 2Kin 19:21 = Isa 37:22; Micah 4:8; Zeph 3:14; Zech 9:9; Lam 2:13, 15; compare בַּתמּֿוּצַי‎ Zeph 3:10 daughter of my dispersed ones; בַּתצֹֿר‎ Psa 45:13; ׳ב בָּבֶל‎ Jer 50:42; 51:33; Psa 137:8; ב ׳בְּתוּלַת בָּבֶל‎ Isa 47:1; see further Zech 2:11; also of Tarshish Isa 23:10, Sidon 23:12 (+ בְּתוּלַת‎), Dibon Jer 48:18 (+ יוֺשֶׁבֶת‎), Gallim Isa 10:30; יְֿהוּדָה׳ב בְּתוּלַת‎ Lam 1:15; compare יְהוּדָה בַּת מִבְצְרֵי‎ 2:2; בַּתעַֿמִּי‎ daughter of my people Isa 22:4; Jer 4:11; 6:14, 26; 8:11, 19, 21, 22; Jeremiah 8:23; 9:6; Lam 3:48; 4:3, 6, 10, ב ׳בְּתוּלַת ׳י‎ Jer 14:17; בַּתמִֿצְרָ֑יִם‎ 46:24; also 46:11 (+ בְּתוּלַת‎), 46:19 (+ יוֺשֶׁבֶת‎); ׳ב אֱדוֺם‎ Lam 4:21-22, ׳ב כַּשְׂדִּים‎ Isa 47:1, 5; note הַשּׁוֺבֵבָ֑ה הַבַּת‎ Jer 31:22 (|| יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתוּלַת‎ 31:21) 49:4 (= Ammon); on בַּתאֲֿשֻׁרִים‎ Ezek 27:6 see below אֲשֻׁרִים‎ p. 81; less often in plural הַגּוֺיִם בְּנוֺת‎ 32:16; ׳ב ׳גּ אַדִּרִם‎ 32:18 (these perhaps below

1i); מְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּנוֺת‎ Ezek 16:27 (in allegory); compare also of Sodom, Samaria, Syria etc. V:44; V:45; V:46; V:46; V:53; V:55; V:55; V:57; V:57; 23:2.

4 plural = villages, after name of city, וּבְכָלבְּֿנֹתֶיהָ וּבְחֶשְׁבּוֺן‎ Num 21:25 compare 21:32; 32:42 (E) Josh 15:45, 47 (twice in verse) (J E ?) + 15:28 ᵐ5‎ Di, 17:11 (6 t.) 17:16 (J) = Judg 1:27 (4 t. in verse); 11:26 (twice in verse); Jer 49:2 17t.; Chronicles + 6 t.; Neh 11:25-31. On 1Chr 18:1 & its variation from || 2Sam 8:1 see We Dr.

5 in phrases denoting character, quality, etc., נֵכָר בַּתאֵֿל‎ daughter of a strange god, i.e. idolatrous (woman or people) Mal 2:11; בַּתגְּֿדוּר‎ daughter of a troop, i.e. war-like city Micah 4:14; הַשִּׁיר בְּנוֺת‎ Eccl 12:4 the daughters of song, i.e. songs, melodious notes; בַּתבְּֿלִיַּעַל‎ 1Sam 1:16 see בְּלִיַּעַל‎ below בלה‎.

6 יַעֲנָה בַּת‎ = ostrich Lev 11:16 = Deut 14:15; plural יַעֲנָה בְּנוֺת‎ Job 30:29; Micah 1:8; Isa 13:21; 34:13; 43:20; Jer 50:39 (see יַעֲנָה‎); בַּתעַֿיִן‎ pupil of the eye Lam 2:18 compare Ethiopic see also אישׁוֺן‎

7 figurative בָנוֺת שְׁתֵּי לַעֲלוּקָה‎ Prov 30:15 two daughters (i.e. Sh®°ôl & the barren womb, compare Comm.)

8 of vine = branch עֲלֵישֿׁוּר צָֽעֲרָה בָּנוֺת‎ Gen 49:22 compare Di & v: below בֵּן‎.

9 as noun relative (all P), of age of woman שָׁנָה בַּתתִּֿשְׁעִים‎ Gen 17:17; of ewe-lamb בַּתשְֿׁנָתָהּ‎ Lev 14:10; Num 6:14; of she-goat id. 15:27. compare בֵּן‎ 9 — II. בַּת‎ see below בתת‎.

I. בַּת‎ daughter see below בן‎.

בת רבים.def:
H4428. melek

I. מֶ֫לֶךְ‎2513 noun masculine king (Late Hebrew id.; MI1, 5, 10, 18, 23 מלך‎; Neh 1:4 המלכן‎; Phoenician מלך‎; Zinjirli מלך‎ DHMSendsch. 60; Assyrian maliku, malku, prince (Assyrian šarru = king); Arabic king (original Hebrew *מַלִח‎ inferred, LagBN 73 BaNB § 112 WMMAs. u. Europ.76); Sabean מלכן‎ SabDenkmNo. 1; construct מלך‎, plural אמלך‎ CISiv 37; compare Ethiopic God (and Nöl.c.); Aramaic , מְלֵיךְ‎; Palmyrene מלכא מלך‎ VogNo. 28; Nabataean מלכא‎ EutNab. 1); — ׳מ‎ absolute Gen 14:7 + (insert also 2Sam 13:17 ᵐ5‎ Th We Dr Kit Bu, and 13:34 ᵐ5‎ We Dr Kit Bu); in p. always מֶ֑לֶךְ‎ Gen 49:20 238t. (so also proper name in מֶלֶךְ‎-); construct 14:1 +; suffix מַלְכִּי‎ 2 Samuel 19:44 6t., etc.; plural מְלָכִים‎ 14:9 +; מְלָכִין‎ Prov 31:3; construct מַלְכֵי‎ Gen 17:16 +; suffix מְלָכֶיהָ‎ Isa 7:16 3t.; מַלְכֵיהֶם‎ Deut 7:24 16t., etc.; —

1 king: of Egypt Gen 39:20f.; Exod 1:8f.; Deut 11:3; 1Kin 3:1; of Mesopotamia, Shinar, Assyria, Babylon, Persia, etc. Judg 3:8, 10; Gen 14:1f.; 2Kin 15:19-20, 29; 17:3f.; 18:13f.; 24:1, 11f.; Ezra 1:1f.; 4:3f.; Est 1:2 +, 1Kin 11:18, 40; 14:25; 2Kin 17:4f.; 23:29 +; of Canaan, Philistia, Edom, Moab, etc. (often of single city): Gen 14:2f.; 14:18; 20:2; 26:1, 8; 36:31; Num 20:14; 21:1f.; 22:4, 10; Deut 1:4; 3:1f.; Josh 2:2 (often in Joshua), Judg 1:7; 5:19; 8:5, 12; 11:12f.; 2Kin 3:4f. +; of Aram, Hamath, etc. 2Sam 8:3f. 8:9; 1Kin 15:18; 20:1f.; 22:3; 2Kin 5:1f.; 8:7f.; 8:29; 9:14-15, 15:37; 16:5f. +; of Tyre, etc. 2Sam 5:11; 1Kin 5:15; 9:11, 16+, etc.; especially of Israel (undivided, and of both divisions) Gen 36:31; Num 23:21; 24:7; Deut 17:14f.; Judg 17:6; 18:1; 19:1; 21:25; 1Sam 2:10; 8:5f.; 2Sam 2:4f.; 1Kin 1:33-34,f. + very often; compare also Judg 9:5. — 2Sam 18:29b strike out ׳הַמּ‎ We Klo Dr Kit Bu. Note that in early books דוד המלך‎ is nearly always said; in late books usually וגו ׳שׁלמה המלך‎) דוד‎; compare Aramaic מַלְכָּא כּוֺרֶשׁ‎, etc.

2 of Davidic king, as under divine protection, 1Sam 2:10 (|| מְשִׁיחוֺ‎), Psa 2:6; Psalm 18:51; 89:19; 61:7, compare 99:4; so in (Messianic) prediction Hosea 3:5; Isa 32:1; Jer 23:5; Ezek 37:22, 24; Zech 9:9.

3 used of ׳י‎ as king of Israel 1Sam 12:12; in poetry Deut 33:5 compare Psa 5:3; 10:16; 29:10; 44:5; 48:3; 68:25; 74:12; 84:4; 145:1; 149:2; Isa 41:21; 43:15; 44:6; Zeph 3:15; הַכָּבוֺד מֶלֶךְ‎ Psa 24:7; 24:8; 24:9; 24:10 (twice in verse); universal king 47:3; 47:8; 95:3; 98:6; Jer 10:7, 10, compare 46:18; 48:15; 51:57; Zech 14:9, 16, 17; Mal 1:14; of false god Amos 5:26.

4 in fable, king of trees Judg 9:8, 15 figurative of crocodile Job 41:26; ׳מ לָאַרְבֶּה אֵין‎ Prov 30:27; of death, בַּלָּהוֺת מֶלֶךְ‎ Job 18:14.

5 combinations are: —

a. ׳הַמּ הַגָּדוֺל‎ 2Kin 18:19, 28 = Isa 36:4, 13 (of Assyrian king: compare Assyrian šarru rabu); ׳מ גָּדוֺל‎ Eccl 9:14 (indefinite); of ׳י‎ Mal 1:14, ׳מ ׳ג עַלכֿלאֿלהים‎ Psa 95:3; עוֺלָם ׳מ‎ Jer 10:10 (of ׳י‎); ׳מ מְלָכִים‎ Ezek 26:7 (king of Babylon)

b. הַמֶּלֶךְ יְחִי‎ 1Sam 10:24; 2Sam 16:16 (twice in verse); 1Kin 1:34, 39; 2Kin 11:12; 2Chr 23:11; בירושׁלם מֶלֶךְ‎ Eccl 1:1, compare Eccl 15:26; 2Sam 5:2; 1Kin 14:2; 1Chr 29:25; 2Sam 2:11 (מ עלהֿיה ׳בחברון‎) 1Kin 11:37; 2Chr 28:4; Eccl 1:12.

c. following a verb (one or two accusative) מ ׳שִׂים על‎ Deut 17:14-15, (twice in verse); 1Sam 10:19; מ לָנוּ ׳שִׂים‎ 8:5; לְמ ׳שִׂים‎ 1Kin 10:9; מ ׳נָתַן לְ‎ 1Sam 8:6; Hosea 13:10-11, עַל נָתַן‎ 1Sam 12:13; 2Chr 2:10; Neh 9:37; 13:26; לְמֶלֶךְ הִמְלִיךְ‎ Judg 9:6; 1Sam 15:11; מ ׳הִמְלִיךְ על‎ 12:1; מ ׳הִמְלִיךְ לְ‎ 8:22; עַל מ ׳מָשַׁח‎ Judg 9:8; לְמ ׳מָשַׁח‎ 1Kin 1:45; לְמ ׳מָשַׁךְ עַל‎ Judg 9:15; 1Sam 15:1, 17; 2Sam 2:4; 5:3, 12; 12:7; 1Kin 1:34; 1Chr 11:3; 14:8; ׳מ על יִהְיֶה‎ 1Sam 8:19; למ ׳בִּקֵּשׁ על‎ 2Sam 3:17; על לְמ ׳הֵכִין‎ 5:12; 1Chr 14:2; מ ׳הֵקִים על‎ 1Kin 14:14; Deut 28:36; י עַלכִּֿסֵּא ׳יָשַׁב ׳לְמ וגו ׳תַּחַת‎ 1Chr 29:23, compare Prov 20:8; לְמ עַלכִּֿסֵּא ׳נָתַן ׳לְי אלהיך‎2Chr 9:8.

d. מַעֲדַנֵּימֶֿלךְ‎ Gen 49:20 royal dainties, figurative; הַמּ ׳מִשְׁתֵּה‎ 1Sam 25:36 royal feast (in simile); הַמּ ׳אֶבֶן‎ 2Sam 14:26 king's weight; ׳יַדהַֿמּ‎ 1Kin 10:13 royal bounty (in simile); הַמּ ׳גִּזֵּי‎ Amos 7:1 king's mowings; מ ׳מִקְדַּשׁ‎ 7:13 royal sanctuary; מַלְכָּם עֲטֶרֶת‎ 2Sam 12:30 crown of their king = 1Chr 20:2 (but read ᵐ5 מִלְכֹּם‎ We Klo Dr Kit Kau — not Bu KitChr. Hpt); compare also שָׁוֵה גַּן, עֵמֶק, בַּיִת,‎, etc. — proper name עבד מלך, נתן, מלך, אלימלך, אחימלך, אבימלך,‎, see below אח אב,‎, etc.

מַלְכִישׁוּעַ‎ proper name, masculine son of Saul my king (= ׳י‎) is opulence, compare GrayProp. N. 147); — 1Sam 14:49; 31:2; 1Chr 8:33; 9:39; 10:2 (in Chronicles מַלְכִּישֿׁוּעַ‎). ᵐ5‎ Μελχεισα, Μελχεσουε, etc.
